components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Name plus Work/About links in small tracked uppercase; hover, focus, and the current page shift to Wet Red.
components.html:
Abby Cromwell
  • Work
  • About
components.css: .ds-site-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Jost, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text, #241210); background: var(--color-bg, #F6F0E7); padding: 16px; } .ds-site-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-site-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #A93631); } .ds-site-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--color-accent, #A93631); outline: 1px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-name { font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 12px 24px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav-links [aria-current="page"] { color: var(--color-accent, #A93631); }

components.name: Kicker Label
components.description: Wet Red uppercase label that opens interior page intros and detail columns.
components.css: .ds-kicker { margin: 0; color: var(--color-accent, #A93631); font-family: var(--font-sans, Jost, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Scroll Cue
components.description: Name Red uppercase anchor link with a downward arrow, pointing at the selected-work section.
components.css: .ds-scroll-cue { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-hero-name, #570000); font-family: var(--font-sans, Jost, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-scroll-cue:hover, .ds-scroll-cue:focus-visible { color: var(--color-accent, #A93631); } .ds-scroll-cue > span { font-size: 0.9em; }

components.name: Artwork Preview Card
components.description: 3:2 homepage preview tile with a 1px paper hairline; production fills it with Abby's artwork, edge to edge.
components.css: .ds-art-card { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; width: 14rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-bg, #F6F0E7); background: #ECD1BD; } .ds-art-card-fill { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 70% 20%, #D9855B, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(90% 110% at 20% 85%, var(--color-accent, #A93631), transparent 55%), #ECD1BD; }

components.name: Work Tease Panel
components.description: Short full-width homepage panel linking to Work: artwork anchored right, Name Red label pinned top-left, 2% zoom on hover.
components.css: .ds-tease { position: relative; display: block; height: 8rem; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tease-art { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(80% 140% at 85% 50%, var(--color-bg-dark, #241210), transparent 65%), radial-gradient(110% 100% at 55% 30%, var(--color-accent, #A93631), #D9855B); transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tease-label { position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px; color: var(--color-hero-name, #570000); font-family: var(--font-sans, Jost, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tease:hover .ds-tease-art, .ds-tease:focus-visible .ds-tease-art { transform: scale(1.02); }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Full-bleed gallery card: artwork under a Pooled Dark wash with paper text; hover thins the wash and zooms the art 2%. Production layers a real image behind the wash.
components.html: 01 / Case studyProject forthcomingOpen case study →
components.css: .ds-work-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; aspect-ratio: 1.13 / 1; width: 16rem; padding: 24px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--color-text-on-dark, #F6F0E7); background: radial-gradient(120% 100% at 30% 30%, var(--color-accent, #A93631), var(--color-bg-dark, #241210) 70%); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, Jost, sans-serif); } .ds-work-card::after { content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 0; background: var(--color-dark-overlay, rgb(36 18 16 / 72%)); transition: background 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-work-card:hover::after, .ds-work-card:focus-visible::after { background: var(--color-dark-overlay-soft, rgb(36 18 16 / 32%)); } .ds-work-card span, .ds-work-card small { font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-work-card strong { max-width: 14ch; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Case Placeholder
components.description: Paper Wash field with hairline block borders and one uppercase label, holding the case-study hero slot until content lands.
components.css: .ds-case-placeholder { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 10rem; border-block: 1px solid var(--color-border, #C9A995); color: var(--color-text-secondary, #5A201D); background: var(--color-paper-overlay, rgb(246 240 231 / 84%)); } .ds-case-placeholder span { font-family: var(--font-sans, Jost, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio feels like artwork placed on warm paper beside a translucent watercolor anatomy study. Its visual world is spacious, organic, intimate, and slightly uncanny without becoming clinical or gory. Abby's real work supplies the detail and color; the interface remains restrained enough to frame it.

The homepage is one continuous paper field: a coral watercolor wash carries a monumental left-anchored name, three artwork previews gather low, and a slim "Recent project" panel closes the page. The deep dried-oxblood gallery lives on the Work page, where full-bleed artwork sits under dark pooled washes. The About and Case Study pages share a quieter version of the same paper field.
keyCharacteristics: Pale paper fields crossed by one authored coral watercolor image
Geometric display lettering with a compressed, poster-like rhythm
Asymmetrical compositions and deliberate shifts between light and dark
Real artwork used at meaningful scale, never decorative placeholders

rules.name: The Watercolor Concentration Rule
rules.body: Use the palette as material: broad pale fields, concentrated dark regions, and small wet-red points of interaction.

rules.name: The Six Pigments Rule
rules.body: The palette owns exactly six source values. A new role gets an alias or a derived wash of an existing pigment before it ever gets a new hex.

rules.name: The One Monument Rule
rules.body: Only one typographic element per view may dominate the composition.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat on the paper. Depth is earned by material (washes, overlap, scale), never by decorative box shadows.

dos: Do let Abby's original artwork provide the visual complexity.
Do use the watercolor hero image as one atmospheric field.
Do keep the case-study placeholder clearly labeled until Abby supplies its content.
Do preserve direct access to Work and About.
Do check every composition at narrow and wide viewport sizes.
donts: Don't use stock imagery or generated imitations of Abby's work.
Don't use literal anatomy labels, gore, glossy effects, or glass panels.
Don't introduce new category menus or explanatory sections beyond the selected source pages.
Don't place artwork inside generic white application cards.
Don't add a seventh pigment; extend the palette with aliases and washes of the six source values.
